svg.title: Integration sequence
svg.desc: Chunk: 1. Resource ownership, Deliverables: Per-tab ordering, leases, bounded admission, cancellation, deadlines, memory-pressure reclamation, runtime metrics, Evidence required: Public command tests for ownership, ordering, independent progress, overload, cancellation and protected reclamation; Chunk: 2. Observations, Deliverables: Bounded incremental snapshots, action receipts, event-driven conditions, schema-checked extraction, Evidence required: DOM changes reconstructed from deltas; navigation invalidation; observer cleanup; schema errors; no secret field leakage; Chunk: 3. Execution, Deliverables: Batches, parameterized workflows, checkpoints, repair adapter and recovery, Evidence required: Stop at failing step; detect uncertain side effects after interruption; verify postconditions before advancing; Chunk: 4. Integrations, Deliverables: Persistent Python, TypeScript and Swift clients; task resource profiles; cross-origin frames and visual targeting, Evidence required: Live fixture journeys using each client and command through CLI/MCP; Chunk: 5. Operations, Deliverables: On-demand local inspector, bounded redacted failure bundles, optional recording, Evidence required: Inspector reflects live queues and ownership; idle capture off; bundle content and retention checks; Chunk: 6. Proof and presentation, Deliverables: Frozen baseline comparisons, concurrency matrix, bounded lifecycle validation, docs and cool-color desktop/mobile SVGs, Evidence required: Raw measurements, honest target assessment, full regression suite, rendered visual inspection
